results.evidence_text: Carbohydrate (sodas/juices and bakery products), and Cheese (cheeses). High adherence to the Traditional (OR 2.82, 95%CI: 1.569-5.099) and Carbohydrate Patterns (OR 2.14, 95%CI: 1.470-3.128) showed a promoting effect for PC, whereas the Prudent and Cheese Patterns were independent factors.
results.manual_review_reason: Exposure is a PCA-derived Cheese dietary pattern score composed solely of cheeses; unclear whether this counts as a separable dairy exposure (INCLUDE) or a pattern index (S2-COMPOUND), and dairy as a whole is not evaluated.
results.one_sentence_explanation: The abstract reports a factor-analysis-derived Cheese pattern (cheeses only) with a null association for prostate cancer, but whether this pattern score is a separable dairy exposure or an inseparable dietary index cannot be uniquely resolved from title and abstract.
